ttea.core

Core camera and calibration package of the T-TEA platform.

Developed by the Larva UDESC team.

This package provides the camera capture thread, MediaPipe pose detection and filtering, and the geometry used to calibrate the projection.

Attributes

__version__str

The current version of the package.

__date__str

The release date of this version.

__author__str

The development team.

__license__str

The license under which the package is distributed.

Notes

This package is maintained by the Larva UDESC team and is under active development. Contributions and bug reports are welcome at: https://github.com/larvattea/ttea
